name: Love in the Crossfire
summary: During the war between Sheng and Yu kingdoms, Sheng was defeated. On her deathbed, the Sheng princess tasked her maid, Ayue, to impersonate her, marry for peace, and steal Yu's defense map. Meanwhile, in Yu, Prince Chu Ruheng, branded a "rebellious son," seeks the truth behind his mother's mysterious death. A "fake princess" and a "disgraced prince" cross paths in a treacherous palace. Amid suspicion and love, they join forces to uncover secrets and fight for peace.

name: Маяк
summary: This is a story about a family trying to survive a terrible grief. The father works in the police, the mother is an ambulance doctor. Both are rarely at home, so high school student Egor has to stay with his brother, who suffers from a severe form of cerebral palsy. One of these days, a tragedy occurs, which, it seemed, could not be worse.

name: Фейк
summary: Lyceum teacher Rita begins to be stalked online. The stalker hits her where it hurts: work, students, family, and self-confidence. Rita tries to understand: who is this person and what does he want? But there are too many people around her who would like to turn her life into a nightmare.

name: Мамин сын
summary: A talented student, the life of the party, a handsome athlete. Tyoma is twenty, and everything is great for him. At home, too, everything is idyllic, because Vika is not just his mother, but his best friend, his support and his ideal woman. But suddenly, there is alarming and very "adult" news that destroys the hero's ideal world. Now, in order to understand how to live on, both Vika and Tyoma will have to realize a simple thought: they both need to grow up.

name: Как вырастить маньяка?
summary: In three episodes, the mothers of the most famous maniacs talk about their sons: about their birth and growing up. How did the Bitsevsky maniac come into the world, was the Penza cannibal a vegetarian, and how has the mother of the Kopeysky strangler been trying to justify her son for 20 years?

name: Teen Predator/Online Killer
summary: How does a Northern Irish teen become one of the world's worst online child sex abusers? Victims, families and police share how catfish killer Alexander McCartney was caught.

name: S.E.R.E.G.
summary: Lieutenant-Colonel Zsolt Győrbíró is trying to correct an old mistake in a new NATO mission, while also trying to hold his own as a father and husband. His situation is not made easier by his old teammate, Colonel Tibor Horváth, who is playing with all his strength - if necessary, even with questionable means - to have Zsolt declared unfit to lead the mission. The life of the younger Győrbíró, the reluctant medical student Marci, is also changed by the basic training, to which her explosive father sends her as a punishment. However, the unexpected adventure makes a new man out of the boy, who finds not only a new profession, but also love.  I wonder how the mission team is assembled, who manages to get to Iraq, what happened to their teammate in the past, and will the special military unit of S.E.R.E.G. be successful in the "revenge campaign"? A series about a sniper soldier who was forced to work in an office after a failed mission in Iraq years ago, but now he gets a new chance: he can go into the field again. His situation is complicated by his bad relationship with Link's university son, as well as by his fellow soldier who considers him incompetent, but in the end he successfully trains a sniper platoon, with whom he goes on a mission again, putting an end to his failed mission five years earlier.

previousepisode.name: A fejsze felejt, de a fa emlékezik

name: Pup Gear
summary: Dash into the PAW Patrol garage for a look at some of the pups favourite vehicles.

name: From Bureaucrat to Villainess: Dad's Been Reincarnated!
summary: After a traffic accident, 52-year-old civil servant Kenzaburou Tondabayashi awakens to find he's become Grace Auvergne, a duke's daughter, and more importantly the villainess of an otome game. Not wanting to get in the way of the happy endings of the young characters around him, Grace sets out to play the role of the villain, but whether it's due to Kenzaburou's memories of being an affectionate parent getting in the way or not being able to remember those pesky foreign names properly, it ends up being a lot harder than it looks…

previousepisode.name: Dad Celebrates at the Campus Festival

name: Milkshake! Movers
summary: Join Derek in the Milkshake Studio, where he teaches us the dance moves to some of his favourite songs, with the help of Shake, the Milkshake music speaker!

name: I'm Living with an Otaku NEET Kunoichi!?
summary: The manga centers on Tsukasa, a normal salaryman who is attacked one night by demons, and is saved by a genius kunoichi named Shizuri. In her off time though, Shizuri is a lazy otaku NEET. Tsukasa and Shizuri end up living together, with Tsukasa using his homemaking skills to pamper Shizuri as she continues to serve as his bodyguard.

previousepisode.name: The NEET Kunoichi Somehow Had a Drinking Party

name: Shop With BET
summary: This marketplace highlights Black-owned and inclusive brands across various product categories. Just in time for the holiday season, Shop With BET offers a unique shopping experience for BET's audience, featuring selected items that celebrate Black founders, small businesses, and culturally inclusive products. This platform underscores BET's commitment to promoting equity and representation, making commerce more accessible, seamless, and culturally relevant.

name: The ARIA Music Awards
summary: Australia's most prestigious celebration of musical talent, with a special presentation on Channel 9 and 9Now.

name: Шоу большой страны
summary: Each episode of the program features witty sketches featuring popular artists. Mikhail Galustyan, Stanislav Duzhnikov, Georgy Dronov, Maria Kravchenko, Maxim Lagashkin, Alexey Maklakov, Svetlana Permyakova, Marina Fedunkiv, Maxim Kiselev, Ivan Pyshnenko and other artists of different genres will tell you what one seventh of the land lives on, and they will do it funny. "The Big Country Show" is about Russia and for Russia.

name: Перекресток
summary: A family saga about ordinary residents of Alma-Ata during the difficult period of the 90s. Family stories echo the history of the country. The modest life of yesterday's public sector workers and the luxurious apartments of the new Russians and Kazakhs. How to get used to a new life without losing humanity?

name: Битва умов
summary:
The participants of the game  must guess the most common answers of ordinary people to simple questions that cannot be answered unambiguously. For example, "What food do the French like most?" The answers are usually completely unpredictable and funny. You can be sure that ten out of a hundred random passers-by think that janitors maintain order in the country. And imagine how many answer options there are to the questions "What does a woman do when her heel breaks?" or "What insects are most often killed?"
"Battle of the Minds" is a team game. Each player must express their opinion, offer their version, but victory or defeat goes to the whole team. Most often,  the selection is based on professional criteria, but popular singers, actors, and athletes often take part in it.
Two teams compete on the court, the whole process consists of five "games" - simple, double, triple, reverse game and big game.

previousepisode.name: Ein toter Schüler kann nicht leben!

name: Я почти знаменит
summary: A talent show, whose participants demonstrate their unique abilities to the entire country. The project's motto is not to lose heart and remain bright and unrivaled, despite difficult times. In each qualifying round, 11 participants will fight for a place in the final. And only if all jury members approve of the performance and all three stars light up, the participant goes further. Each jury member has a golden button. Only once during the entire project, they can use it to let a participant through to the final, for whom not all the judges voted, and give him a chance to earn the main prize - three million rubles. In the first qualifying round: pancake juggling, push-ups on nails, fingerboarding, tongue twisters and much more.

name: Стартаперы
summary:
Out of hundreds of applicants from all over the country, only 16 people made it to Startuppers. Some have invented an engine, some have an idea to open an atypical theater, others dream of winning the hearts of viewers with their culinary startups, and some want to become a producer of their own music label. The Startuppers show will show whose projects will see the light of day, and who will turn the page with a business idea.

The participants will have to fight for a meeting with investors ready to help develop the brightest startup project! In the meantime: creative tests for stress resistance and business acumen, overcoming oneself, meetings with star guests, master classes, competitive struggle, the bitterness of defeats and the taste of the first victories.

name: Голоса
summary: As a result of a terrible personal drama, Lizaveta Zaretskaya developed the ability to read other people's thoughts. She was always on the way to this. But only great grief opened a certain shutter in her consciousness. After the disappearance of her only daughter Dasha, Liza's life turned into hell. And only her work in the department for the search for people keeps her in this world. And also a weak hope of finding Dasha...

name: Выхожу тебя искать
summary: Mikhail and Denis Demirov work in the department for searching for missing persons. The brothers are absolutely not alike - neither in character, nor in habits, nor in their attitude to life. Psychologist Rita Vysotskaya comes to work in their department. And soon both brothers find themselves drawn into a complex love triangle. Mikhail and Denis do not realize that Rita has a secret. The girl works in the department with one goal - she wants to "find herself": Rita does not know her real name, she remembers herself only from the moment she was hit by a car in a small provincial town

name: Седьмая руна
summary: In the city of N-sk, the governor's daughter dies under mysterious circumstances. Investigator Oleg Nesterov arrives from Moscow to N-sk to find out the circumstances of her death. In the place where the girl's body was found, a role-playing game based on the Karelian-Finnish epic "Kalevala" was taking place, and the chairwoman of the role-players, Vera, simultaneously begins her own investigation. However, new victims and a series of mysterious events confuse Oleg and Vera more and more. And soon Nesterov realizes that role-players are not the only ones playing in N-sk. The banker, the prosecutor, and the governor are all involved in some strange gambling game, the meaning of which is hidden from the uninitiated.

name: Господа-товарищи
summary: The young Soviet republic is invested by a number of "white" armies. Inside Moscow there are armies of criminal outcasts. Newly created Moscow Criminal Investigation Department tries to make a difference under this conditions.

name: Knok
summary: Quentin, a small-time employee of a urinal company, witnesses a murder during an inspection at a gas station. He meets Blanche, a contract killer working for an application called Knok. Now an inconvenient witness, Quentin has no choice but to become a hitman himself, working in tandem with Blanche.

name: Долгий путь домой
summary: Nadya lives in the village with her parents. One day she meets a Muscovite, Vitaly Bolshakov, and immediately falls in love with the young and promising guy. Despite having a fiancé at home, the girl is determined to conquer the capital and the heart of her new lover. Meanwhile, in Moscow, Vitaly has his own life, work, and beloved woman. The persistent Nadya is not ready to just give him up to another, so she intends to do everything in her power to win her place in the sun. But will this bring her happiness?

name: Чужая женщина
summary:
Vera considers herself a happy woman who has a loving husband, a good home and prosperity. Everything in her life is peaceful and smooth until trouble comes to the house. The heroine's husband, a successful businessman Dmitry, dies in an accident.
Now Vera is a widow. She has to cope with difficulties herself, manage the business and support her mother-in-law. But troubles never come alone - it turns out that her deceased husband had a mistress, Yulia, and she is pregnant! Moreover, her mother-in-law, whom Vera treats like a mother, suddenly begins to take care of Yulia and eventually declares that she will not abandon her grandson - after all, he is "the only blood relative in this world."
It is strange, but it is in these far from rosy circumstances that the heroine begins her path to true female happiness.

name: Yesterday Live
summary: The program "Yesterday Live" turned the templates and stereotypes that the modern viewer is accustomed to on their head. The objects of ridicule were a variety of television genres covering local and international events, cinema, social life, sports, etc. The name itself sounds paradoxical.

name: Чё по фокусам?
summary: Magic tricks are a form of art that amazes both small children and adults. Illusionists sometimes do the impossible, and to do this they use incredible sleight of hand and the ability to act quietly and quickly. Hosts Alexey and Nazar invite celebrity guests to their place in order to make them doubt what they have seen. A popular performer whose money disappears in an unknown direction, a comedian whose passport will be mercilessly destroyed by fire, a famous blogger whose license will be confiscated, and many others come here. At the end of the episode, a winner is determined, and the magician who received the fewest votes suffers an unexpected punishment.

name: Ancient Forensic Expert
summary: Healer Qu Zhen and Prince Rong Jin Sheng join forces to combat a deadly poison spreading through Dasheng. As they face misunderstandings, assassins, and political intrigue, Qu Zhen's skill and determination are tested. Together, they journey through perilous lands, seeking a cure and uncovering dark secrets that threaten the empire.

name: MONEYпуляторы
summary: They have no special education, but sometimes they act more confidently than experienced psychologists. They make you feel euphoria and delight, and also pain and fear. They hide behind high positions, present diamonds and offer to start a joint business. Relationships with them are exciting, but in the end the "lovers" inevitably find out that they were deceived. Four lonely women who fell into the traps of romantic swindlers will tell their stories.

name: Behind the Scenes
summary: An 80-million robbery shakes the bank in the Republican era. Cheng Ru's father dies in the heist, and to uncover the truth behind his death, Cheng Ru becomes a nightclub singer and approaches the Chamber of Commerce president, Yan Liang. As their power struggle intensifies, their feelings for each other begin to grow. Meanwhile, Cheng Ru uncovers her fiancé Cheng Feng's secret, and the mystery deepens.

name: Pearl Hotel
summary: Pearl Hotel once stood on an execution ground from the late Qing Dynasty, shrouded in heavy, ominous energy. A blood-soaked peachwood sword was hidden within the hotel to ward off evil spirits. Rural newcomer Ma Xiaodao takes on the role of security guard at this infamous hotel, but he accidentally shatters the sword, drawing the scorn and anger of the building's strange residents. Soon, bizarre occurrences begin to spiral out of control throughout the hotel…

name: 50 nuances de Grecs
summary: Sex, football, politic, immigrants drama, ART, harassment or serial-killers : When we open the Pandora's box of news, blending the Gods, heroes and monsters of our civilization, we don't see the world with the same eyes. Collision between the classical culture and our modern tics, this new series is as satiric as educational.

name: À Musée vous, À Musée moi

previousepisode.name: In the Car, Roy Lichtenstein (3/3) : Lost

name: Blood River
summary: A mother escapes from a harsh Boer community to find her daughter, who is being held prisoner by the Zulus. This gritty and romantic series explores a seminal episode in South African history.

name: Eva & Nicole
summary: Paris 1972. Eva and Manuel make love in an attic when the French gendarmerie breaks down the door and forcibly takes the girl away to be deported to her country of origin. Marbella 1985. Nicole has married Manuel and has become a powerful woman, owner of the Marbella nightlife and the fashionable nightclub, Nicole's. She has managed to gather the entire jet. Everything points to a perfect night, but the arrival of a stranger surprises everyone: it is Eva.

name: Ein Fall für Katharina Tempel
summary: Commissioner Katharina Tempel is moving from the LKA to the criminal investigation department in Hamburg. Under the leadership of her new superior, Chief Inspector Georg König, she begins the murder investigation in the Hanseatic city. She is supported by her new colleague Dela Tahiri, her husband Volker, the celebrated press spokesman for the Hamburg police, and her best friend and prosecutor Golda Hopkins.

name: Neuf Meufs
summary: Nine snapshots during the day of nine women of different ages who live in the same Parisian building without necessarily knowing each other, who desire, dare, doubt, amuse and touch us.

name: H24
summary: Between patients, doctors and private life, the 4 nurses of H24 take up new challenges every day in the surgical emergencies of Fleming Hospital.

name: Bête noire
summary: Bête noire presents the side effects of an unforgivable act committed by Jérémy, a 16-year-old teenager. With the help of the investigating psychiatrist-coroner, his mother tries to figure out how her son, a seemingly trouble-free boy, came to commit an act of hate. What was the trigger for this nightmare? When did everything change? Together, the two women make it their mission to unravel the mystery of Jérémy.

name: Têtard
summary: Têtard wants to be the initiatory journey of these two parents in the making, awaiting this unidentified object which is their unborn child.

name: Mike
summary: He was at the top of the charts, but now he's at the bottom of the scale... Mike is a singer who had a fleeting glory in the early 2000s: he sold a million singles of his song "Dis-le moi en face," a very trendy French pop tune. But since then his inspiration, his fans and his savings have all left him.

name: The Mafia's Obsession
summary: Augusto Castro can't stand the thought of his only sister Alice getting hitched to some monster man due to an old-school marriage pact from 15 years back. He decides to pull a fast one on the agreement and steps in to marry the notorious mob boss, Pietro, in her place. Little did he know, it was all a love trap set by Pietro.

name: Enjoy !
summary: It follows a delivery boy for fictional home-delivery app Enjoy!, who lands a dream job as an intern on a 24-hour news channel with a reactionary editorial line. His destiny soon collides with Igor, an ambitious young lawyer who dreams of defending great cases.

name: Tout est vrai (ou presque)
summary: A three minute comedic look at a major celebrity's life and work

name: Eppure cadiamo felici
summary: Gioia is 16 years old: full adolescence, a terrible period for everyone. But she is also affected by all the changes that her mother, Sabrina, young and beautiful, forces her to face.

name: H24 , 24 heures de la vie d'une femme
summary: Inspired by twenty-four real facts, a series written by twenty-four European authors who chronicle violence against women on a daily basis, from the most banal incident to the most terrible tragedy. Twenty-four daring films interpreted by twenty-four exceptional actresses.

name: Gazebo
summary: Marie and Loulou move away from the deafening noise of the city. While Loulou dreams of self-sufficiency, Marie wonders how she will be able to meet her professional commitments and have an exciting social life.

name: Or noir
summary: A group of four thieves from the cities pull off a masterful blow and steal millions of euros in gold bars. How to dispose of this nest egg which stirs up all covetousness? The owners of the gold, the city bosses, the local mafia gangs, the more or less crooked police, everyone wants to recover the treasure and everyone is looking for them.

name: L'Effet secondaire
summary: The side effect is Anouk, Marco, Fanny, Alex, Safa, Emma, Ahmed and many others who are going through high school with their heads filled with plans, doubts and intense emotions! It is also the effect of friendships that transform, unexpected rivalries, loves that are born, adults who take up too much space and trials that weaken. In the corridors of the school as in the courtyards, people stick together and confront each other, have fun and intimidate each other ... In short, it's everyday life, with its ups and downs, turned in a way rhythmic - in the manner of docurality - to capture hyper spontaneous slices of life.

name: Qu'est-ce qu'on attend pour être heureux ?
Bébéatrice
summary: Self-proclaimed "princess"of the family, Bébéatrice reigns supreme! Surrounded by adults, she has assimilated to everything since she first learned to speak.

name: Nemausus
summary: The journey of a Latin-speaking Roman who has traveled through time from Ancient Rome until Nîmes (France) in 2018.

name: Townies
summary: It's The OC in the Old West as we dig deep into the untold story of the teens of the Pioneer Era. Meet Boy, a 13-year old underdog dreamer who hopes to be the world's first hang-WOMAN executioner. Together with her fellow teens, they live it up before they have to grow up, get married, and get killed...at the ripe age of fifteen.

name: Zone 42
summary: And if the monsters actually existed, but you did not know? Ed, Prof, Stan and Wallace take care of limiting the damage to their manners. They work for the underground organization Zone 42, which provides them with everything they need to carry out their missions.

name: Time Mun Wela Tai
summary: Melanie, a young woman who seemed to have everything, lost everything in her life. Just because driving through a tunnel with a 'time distortion' caused her life clock to disappear for a year! Everything she ever had, everything she ever got But her life was changed. It was someone's fault that caused it to be so. She received a 'special thing' instead of an apology, a 'watch necklace' that can turn time forward or backward five times. But with one condition, if she wants to change the date, she must 'kill' one life to use it to get through.

name: Jeroen's Abandoned Adventures
summary: Jeroen van Koningsbrugge explores abandoned structures and buildings in remote places that few people normally visit. With the help of expert Bob Thissen he investigates the stories, and sometimes shocking history, behind these mysterious locations.

name: Rang Badalti Odhani
summary: Khanak a simple, spirited young woman, living in village Dhulwadi, Bhuj , is newly married to her sweetheart, Suraj. In a tragic accident, Suraj is killed. The man who caused Suraj's death is Shantanu Khandelwal , the younger son of a business tycoon called Sunil Khandelwal. Under pressure from the village council (panchayat) of Dhulwadi, Shantanu marries Khanak and takes her to his home in the city. Khanak struggles to adjust to the unfamiliar environment, while Shantanu learns to accept his responsibilities. Meanwhile, Shantanu's arrogant mother Madhavi and sister-in- law Khushboo conspire to separate him from Khanak. This does not happen and Shaan and Khanak fall in love in the end.However, despite it all Khanak joins the family bond watch the family blossom their love and care for each other.

name: The Blubburbs
summary: For centuries, a whale has been swallowing sailors, explorers, scientists and tourists. Now, they're all stuck together in a dysfunctional community inside the whale with neighbors they never asked for. The Blubburbs follows a handful of whale dwellers as they plot to escape the whale, deal with new characters the whale swallows, and generally try to tolerate each other's nonsense.

name: All the President's Men: The Conspiracy Against Trump
summary: All The President's Men: A six-part series exposing the Deep State's coordinated attack on Trump supporters, revealing untold stories of personal sacrifice, political corruption, and the fight to preserve American democracy.

name: Ça, c'est Paris
summary: Gaspard Berthille is the director of Tout-Paris, a famous cabaret that maintains the myth of wild Parisian nights. But unlike his father, Dary, Gaspard has not been able to perpetuate the reputation of the establishment. The arrival of a new investor, accompanied by his son, will shake up Gaspard and profoundly change the lives and destinies of the entire Tout-Paris team.

name: as1one: The Israeli-Palestinian Pop Music Journey
summary:
Throughout this compelling four-part docuseries, music being the ultimate connector is explored in the chronicled journey to create the world's first Israeli-Palestinian pop group. Over a five year period, the band members share their ups and downs including the challenging audition process in 2020; their language barriers, intense rehearsals, emotional highs and lows as they found their footing; navigating the very unexpected world events that happened on October 7th, 2023 – the morning after they flew to LA to record their first album; and the monumental challenges they have faced each day since. With so much more at stake because of the war, the band finds greater purpose in their music now representing something much greater than the six of them.

The docuseries will also feature original music from the group including their debut single, "All Eyes On Us," featuring Nile Rodgers as well as their upcoming single, "Stranger," due this Friday, Nov. 15, and more.

name: Vow of Silence: The Assassination of Annie Mae
summary: This true crime docuseries examines the murder of Annie Mae Aquash – a Mi'kmaq woman from Nova Scotia, Canada,  a mother of two daughters, a teacher, and a revolutionary who fought for Indigenous rights in the 1970s whose death went unsolved for almost 30 years. Set between the sweeping landscape of American politics in the volatile 70s and the present-day investigation by Annie Mae's daughter to uncover secrets from the past, this is a fascinating story of murder, intrigue, love, and betrayal that contextualizes Annie Mae's story within the larger story of the struggle of Native and First Nations women in their own communities that continues even today.

name: Mickey and Minnie's Christmas Carols
summary: These five stop-motion, sing-along shorts feature Mickey, Minnie and their pals as they bring the holiday spirit alive to the tune of popular carols.

name: Name That Tune
summary: The original version of the popular and long-running quiz show, hosted by Red Benson Contestants competed to see who had the more comprehensive knowledge of popular songs by trying to be the first to identify pieces of music. Additional challenges included contestants bidding to see who could "name that tune" in as few notes as possible.

name: Хит
summary:
"Hit" is a documentary project from Wink Originals about music. It will tell you why songs become hits and how music can influence entire eras. 

Vanya Dmitrienko, Shura, IOWA, FEDUK, Yulia Savicheva, Valeria, Fedor Bondarchuk and many others took part in the project. The audience will see how the clips were created, evaluate archival recordings from the filming, and hear the first versions of the hits. The creators of the series will tell about the history of pop music in the format of five-year plans, and at the end of the series they will record a small album with the biggest hits in the entire history of Russian pop: hits of the 90s and beyond are already waiting for you.

name: Spine Chilling Stories
summary: An anthology series of original scary stories featuring dark tales of kids dealing with abnormal, supernatural and downright spine-chilling events.

previousepisode.name: The Headless Mascot Ended My Season

name: Mashin Souzou Den Wataru
summary: Protagonist Wataru Hoshibe, an elementary school student in fourth grade, is a RyuTuber who wants to become a superstar. His adventure begins in the parallel world of Chubukai parallel world alongside Ryujinmaru, a Mashin Wataru created out of blocks to defeat the final boss, Enjoda!

previousepisode.name: 【The Two Saviors】Let's Create! Our Bright Future!

name: Kummeli esittää: Kontio & Parmas
summary: The series follows the everyday life of the Valkeakoski Police Department.

name: Erzgebirgskrimi
summary: Saturday crime series with Stephan Luca as chief inspector Adam and Lara Mandoki as his young, German-Hungarian assistant Karina.

name: О, счастливчик!
summary: A popular TV game show where each participant could earn 1 million rubles using their intelligence and erudition.

name: Into the Big Blue Heart
summary: An incredible journey into the planet's magnificent and magical oceans reveals new revelations about how the seas and their massive currents sustain not only the life within them but all life on Earth.

name: UniverXO Dabiz
summary: He has fame, awards and Michelin stars — but amid an existential crisis, Dabiz Muñoz might close the restaurant that elevated him to world's best chef.

name: The Later Daters
summary: Six silver singles learn the new rules of modern dating while overcoming trust and self-esteem issues on their journey to find meaningful connections.

name: Taste of Australia with Hayden Quinn
summary: Hosted by Hayden Quinn, Taste of Australia takes viewers on a flavourful journey across the country, showcasing the diverse personalities, landscapes & ingredients that define Australia's food scene.

name: 101 Marriages
summary: In 2020, Sheng Shi and Gu Lanshan's marriage, built on deceit and manipulation, began to crumble. Over time, they discovered new beginnings and the true meaning of love.

name: Райский
summary: Maxim Raisky is a talented investigator, capable of accurately revealing the motives of a criminal and recreating the picture of the crime from the most insignificant details. For his colleagues and loved ones, his instincts are a unique gift, but his contradictory character and methods of fighting criminals, on the contrary, are a complete headache.

name: L'Indétectable
summary: For 25-year-old Stéphanie, life takes a dramatic turn the day a compromising and humiliating video of her mother goes viral. Stéphanie is convinced that this video, which destroyed her mother's political career and destabilized her powerful family clan, is fake. This is despite the opinion of all the experts who certify its authenticity. But who would have fabricated this fake, and why? Despite having no prior experience in the field, Stéphanie, who has no talent for lying and is neither a spy nor a police officer, gets hired under a false identity at a startup she suspects has the technological capabilities to create incredibly sophisticated fakes. Drawn against her will into a dangerous conspiracy with international ramifications, Stéphanie will discover that the truth isn't where she expected to find it and that perfect lies come at a very high price.

name: Asura
summary: In 1979 Tokyo, four distinct sisters uncover their aging father's affair, causing their happy facades and bottled-up emotions to slowly unravel.

name: Holidazed
summary: This eight-episode series follows six families from different backgrounds, cultures and generations, all living on the same cul-de-sac, as they gather for the holiday season. During a time when emotions are amplified, each family comes together to celebrate their unique, rich traditions and navigate family eccentricities that ultimately help them discover what they do have in common: LOVE in all its different forms.

name: Love and Strife
summary: After her family is massacred, General's daughter Xu Chuyun enters the capital to uncover the truth. Suspecting the wheelchair-bound Crown Prince Jiang Yunsheng, she marries into his household to investigate. As they work together, misunderstandings fade, and they join forces to solve mysteries and ultimately uncover the truth, united by their shared quest for justice.

name: Uncle
summary: To his nephew Er Pang, Uncle is the ultimate idol. A top student since childhood and a graduate of Harbin Institute of Technology. Uncle possesses a genius-like ability to master almost anything new without being taught. In the 1990s, as China's economy underwent a comprehensive transformation, Uncle, equipped with remarkable skills, was always brimming with new ambitions, which led him to start business after business. Though his "restless" journey was filled with hardships, it was through this constant striving that he came to appreciate the power of having family and friends by his side. In the end, it was his optimistic outlook on life that allowed him to realize his dreams.

name: Milkshake! Games
summary: Join David in the Milkshake! Studio where he will be playing some your favourite Milkshake! games that children can participate in at home.

name: Election 2024
summary: Results, analysis and comment on the general election, along with live reports from around the country on the progress of the count.

name: Neven's Christmas at Cashel
summary: Join celebrated Irish chef Neven Maguire as he celebrates the magic of Christmas at the historic Cashel Palace Hotel in a two-part holiday special.

name: The Late Late Toy Show
summary: Join host Patrick Kielty and a host of kids from all corners of the country for the biggest annual event on Irish television as they will reveal this year's most talked-about toys.

name: På gatan där jag bor
summary: Since Nina's husband passed away, she and her children have received support from friends in the neighbourhood. However, she has met a new man, and has long been hesitant to tell her friends - but now is the time.

name: Bausjen
summary: In the new comedy series Bausjen we meet the six officers Eden, Kjetil, Are, Tina, Øystein and PK who make up a slightly dysfunctional, but charming, police unit in a town outside Oslo. With trust in the police at breaking point, any misstep can lead to disaster. No matter how hard they try to keep peace and order, chaos is never far away, neither at the station nor out in the field.

name: Først til verdens ende
summary: In First to the End of the World, host Martin Johnsrud Sundby gives an epic challenge to four participating couples: they will embark on a 6,000-kilometer race from Marrakesh in Morocco to the End of the World in Norway, and they must get there without boarding a single plane. Without a mobile phone, and with a limited budget, the couples must navigate their way from Morocco via Spain, Portugal, France, Italy, Austria and Germany, before finally reaching the finish line in Norway.

name: Best in Show
summary: Else Kåss Furuseth invites her absolute favourites from Norwegian entertainment to a fun performance in Christiania theatre, where anything can happen.

name: Jon blir bonde
summary: Jon Almaas and his wife Ellen's dream of moving to a farm becomes reality, but life as a farmer becomes tougher than Jon had expected.

name: Legevakten
summary: We follow doctors and nurses at the emergency room in Oslo. Oslo's new emergency room, which is Northern Europe's largest and most modern.

name: Wild Battlegrounds
summary: Wild Battlegrounds tracks how different animals cope with their surroundings.

name: Who Murdered You, Mum?
summary: Daniel Wing investigates the unsolved murder of his own mother, Tina, determined to find out the truth about the tragedy that shaped his past.

name: Кто хочет стать миллионером?
summary: A TV game in which each participant can earn 3 million rubles by answering 15 questions from various fields of knowledge.

previousepisode.name: Выпуск 1028. Полина Горинова и Гарик Пекшев, Александр Щеглов и Дмитрий Фатурович

name: Scoil Samhraidh Willie Clancy
summary:
This hugely popular series will feature entertaining high-end performances and fascinating conversation against this very alluring backdrop. 

As a musical event, Scoil Samhraidh Willie Clancy showcases every single aspect of the tradition – the learners, the festival enthusiasts, the dancers, the singers, the discerning listeners, the younger modern players, and the professionals. Now celebrating 51 years, it continues to attract international crowds and huge talent into the tiny West Clare town of Miltown Malbay year-on-year.

It has become something of a ‘Mecca of Music', and this series showcases the diversity of sights and sounds that can be found there annually. Each episode of this musically exciting series will take us from morning to night during a day at the summer school and features music, song, dance, and chat from a variety of characters from across the globe, and closer to home. Throughout the four episodes, we will meet a diverse and talented cohort of interesting characters.

name: The Way You Come Back
summary: To save her father, young Ayuan is sold into a courtesan house and begins a life of constant change. She becomes a student in Japan, a governor's wife, a woman brave enough to leave an unhappy marriage, and a devoted mother who raises four daughters on her own. Refusing to surrender to fate, Dong Zhujun navigates the power struggles of old Shanghai and rises against the tide, eventually building the legendary Jinjiang Hotel empire.

name: Мы не дети
summary: Yesenia, an unpopular introverted blogger, goes to a children's camp at the insistence of her mother. At the camp, she encounters absurd rules and a strict regime. Meeting the hyperactive Sanka and friendship with Karina and Vadik push Yesenia to fight the system. Together with her new friends, she decides to resist the despotic rules of their teacher and director. Now the fate of the entire camp depends on Yesenia and her friends.

name: Esas Oğlan
summary: What happens when two completely different women whose love lives are not going well come together and start looking for the "Main Boy"?

name: Übel Blatt
summary: Köinzell, a young swordsman wielding the deadly black sword, faces rumors of bloodshed. Pursued by the Traitorous Lances, he battles to uncover the truth behind his quest amidst enemies' corpses.

name: Headliners
summary: Musician and fervent campaigner for inclusion, access and equality, Elly-May Barnes leads the quest to create two bands made up entirely of musicians living with disability.

name: Don't Forget Me
summary: The story speaks of a love that transcends a millennium. The female protagonist, Qin Siyuan, is a shopkeeper who has lived for a thousand years, guarding a small store named Wuwang Pavilion. By day, she welcomes customers and lights up lanterns; by night, she lights lamps to guide the spirits of those on the brink of death. Each lamp she ignites fulfills someone's final wish. However, she cannot fulfill her death wish. Burdened by immense guilt, she is trapped outside the cycle of reincarnation, condemned to an immortal existence. When Shen Zheng accidentally stumbles into the Wuwang Pavilion, a peculiar phenomenon occurs with the Wuwang Lamp. Qin Siyuan realizes that her millennia-long wait has finally led her to the one destined to extinguish her lamp. At the same time, she discovers that Shen Zheng is fated to die before turning twenty and persuades him to stay in the shop to extend his life. "I'll extend your life, and you'll extinguish my lamp." At first glance, it seems like a great deal for Shen Zheng. However, Shen Zheng's rebellious nature clashes with Qin Siyuan's forceful and often violent attempts to control him. The two engage in relentless pursuit and resistance until Shen Zheng eventually yields, becoming her reluctant servant. Together, they embark on a journey to locate the elusive Lamp Extinguishing Cover hidden in the bustling city of Haidu. Amid perilous adventures, their bickering gradually turns into mutual affection.

name: The Night is Still Young
summary: The powerful imperial uncle Ye Beichen often loses sleep and goes crazy thinking about one person: Shangguan Weiyang, his niece-in-law. In his past life, Ye Beichen intended to secretly protect Shangguan Weiyang, but she resentfully shot herself and fell off the city wall donned in red, sinking him into an abyss of devastation. He was agonized and aggrieved, regretting his own fulfillment. So the obsessed Ye Beichen wants to reverse fate even at the expense of his life, just for a chance to see and love her again! In this life, Shangguan Weiyang is reborn, but she is forcibly taken and controlled by her former enemy Ye Beichen! Little did they know that Ye Beichen would be so possessed by his love that he would make his niece-in-law his wife! He is willing to be a murderous devil in Shangguan Weiyang's eyes as long as she is safe. The two of them are deeply entangled in love and hate, like fate unable to rest until death. Despite the most fatal misunderstanding, he keeps his deepest love a secret to himself. Unfortunately, two lifetimes of devoted love result in the most incomprehensible ending…

name: La Confrérie
summary: Having to replace his friend who embodies the Snowman at short notice, Simon sinks into a whirlwind of lies to hide this hobby from his family. He clumsily tries to conceal his new life from his girlfriend Caroline and his children Lily and Félix. His goal: to become the best Snowman of all time!

name: Toutouyoutou
summary: Four women discover aerobics in Blagnac in the early 1980s: a sport little known in France at the time. But it's also a question of espionage, as Jane, the American aerobics teacher, is in fact a spy.

name: El Toro
summary: In the heart of Winnipeg's Anglophone basin in the 1960s, the Charbonneau family had to survive modestly by operating the El Toro snack bar following a financial setback.

name: De Pierre en fille
summary: Obeying only their own rules, Daphnée and Pierre, her parent, travel the vast world and concoct an epic daily life made up of small dangers and great joys; because nothing is more comforting than facing the vagaries of life alongside your faithful shield.

name: Marc et Sophie
summary: Marc and Sophie have launched a challenge, love, tenderness, cuddles and fantasy". They are happy, married, one a veterinarian, the other a doctor, and their shared waiting room is the scene of many adventures: mother-in-law, secretary, concierge, friends... everyone is there!

name: ASKIP, le collège se la raconte
summary: Between insurmountable complexes, thwarted love affairs, difficulty fitting in or false rumors, a group of twelve schoolchildren tell their stories every day. We go from laughter to tears we help each other and we always find a solution at François Truffaut College!

previousepisode.name: Le jour de la fête improvisée

name: 18h30
summary: 6.30 pm is the time at which Eric and Melissa, two colleagues, leave the office each day to go to the same bus stop. Five minutes a day, wedged between work and family life, sketching out the year that will see these two looking for, finding or missing each other. More than just a matter of time, 18h30 is above all a setback.

name: Aşk, Evlilik, Boşanma
summary: The story of three women who are searching for true love despite being married.

name: Farmagia
summary: In Felicidad, farmers known as the Farmagia raise monsters under the peaceful rule of the Magus Diluculum. After the Magus passes, a power struggle erupts among forces using monsters to seize control. In the town of Centvelt, Farmagia Ten and his friends band together against the despotic new ruler, Glaza. Ten, his friends, and their home-grown monsters must stay strong to defend their freedom.

name: Celeste
summary: A tax inspector, Sara Santano, is tasked with proving that Celeste, a Latin music superstar, is a Spanish resident and must pay taxes. A high-stakes pursuit within the dreary world of the Tax Agency.

name: Contre toi
summary: Esther and Fred Cavalieri form a flamboyant couple deeply united with their two children. So why does Esther, a woman seemingly without history and without enemies, find herself in mortal danger? To protect her, Fred hires Mathias, a bodyguard, while the police find the culprit.

name: Géolocaliser l'amour
summary: Géolocaliser l'amour is the series adaptation of the eponymous novel by poems by Simon Boulerice. Through a succession of sexual conquests, we accompany Simon in his nomenclature of disappointments, emotions and disarray that pave the way for his search for a soul mate (or a one-night stand) on dating apps. . Behind the telling of these stories, each more anecdotal than the other, hides a deep loneliness and a need to feel wanted. Simon can only rely on the loyalty of his best friend, Jocelyn, and Siri to get him to say "I love you" without panicking. Will he be able to find love in the age of smart phones?

name: L'amour flou
summary: After 10 years of living together, two adored children and a dog, Romane and Philippe have separated. From this unique adventure, they made a film: "L'Amour flou". So here they are installed in this strange life, which in many ways turns out to be miraculous: the threat of separating no longer exists since it is done, the tensions between Philippe and Romane seem to have disappeared and they now speak the language. friendship. Children, on the other hand, seem to be bathed in happiness, with both parents close at hand. But the daily life of the Rebbot-Bohringer family is as crazy and vague as ever.

name: Clase 406
summary:
High school is the main setting of Clase 406, the realistic chronicle of a group of young people like many others, who live that bundle of years called adolescence with intensity and carelessness, joy and fear.

They study, have fun and, among good friends and bad company, they will learn the difference between dreaming and working to make a dream come true; between demanding attention and earning respect; between promising and committing; between desiring and loving; between being a teenager and being an adult.

name: HP
summary: Sheila, a 20-something intern in psychiatry, discovers a burlesque world and tries to help various patients, like Chantal Marignan, who takes herself for Beyoncé.

name: Chouette, pas chouette
summary: The graphic universes, the identity of the characters and the scenarios were created around the theme of mutual respect. They also aim to fight against ordinary sexism from an early age and in particular to deconstruct clichés of all kinds.

name: Aegon's Conquest
summary: Aegon's Conquest is basically a direct prequel to the hit House of the Dragon, telling the story of the Targaryen's bloody and brutal conquest of Westeros. The story follows the invader Aegon Targaryen, who conquered the continent of Westeros with his sister wives, Rhaenys and Visenya, and their dragons. Aegon successfully unified six of the Seven Kingdoms in just two years, with only Dorne able to successfully resist. An official announcement regarding the same is awaited.

name: Kansas City Star
summary: A semi-famous actress returns to her hometown to work with a regional theater troupe.

name: Vårt lille land - Under Guds øye
The Way
summary: "The path to wisdom requires strength and rigor" said Master Hoang. A 60-second heist as well...

name: Antarctica, the Story of a Man and a Dog Who Challenged the Realm of God
summary: Set in the 1950's, a Japanese Antarctic research exploration team and 19 dogs that accompanied the team are stationed at the Showa Base in Antarctica. After a year, the exploration team is ordered to withdraw from the Antarctic station due to severe weather conditions. The dogs have to be left behind. The following year, the next team arrives at the Showa Base station and a miraculous reunion occurs between a dog handler accompanying the new tean and two dogs, Taro and Shiro, that are brothers.

previousepisode.name: The Curtain Falls〜Transcending Time and Space… The Beginning of the True Miracle 52 Years Ago Concludes!!

name: Dawaland
summary: Eustache, a sensitive and too friendly young bachelor wants to become a "badass", a real one! If Hercules has done the 12 labors, Eustache faces the turpitudes of everyday life, to reveal his dark side at all costs. But things rarely go as planned...

previousepisode.name: Le droit de dire je t'aime

name: Iubire cu parfum de lavandă
summary: The series brings to the fore an original love story, between two mature people, caught between two completely different worlds, but who have the chance to rebuild their lives, next to each other and find happiness beyond all the hardships they have had and continues to take part. Ştefan (Adi Nartea), a former footballer in a top team from Great Britain, used to the rhythm of the luxurious life in the city, but divorced and the father of a teenage child, arrives in the idyllic village where Anda (Michaela Prosan), a single mother, respected doctor in the community where life has a different rhythm. The two end up experiencing a totally unexpected love. Dark secrets, jealousies, intrigues and lies of all kinds will stand in their way every step of the way until they find their way to each other, in a place where people live and love by different rules.

name: Francisco el Matemático: Clase 2017
summary: Francisco Quintana returns to Jimmy Carter School as a teacher. There he encounters young people who follow the rules they themselves create.

name: Fluffle Puff Tales
summary: A Fluffy Pony named Fluffle Puff

previousepisode.name: On a vécu de belles choses

name: ƎNA
summary: ENA, also formatted as ƎNA, is a Peruvian avant-garde animated comedy series, created by Joel Guerra and published on YouTube and Newgrounds. The series combines 2D and 3D animation and draws inspiration from many pieces of surrealist media and worldwide culture, particularly from Peru and Japan. It is set in a strange, almost post-apocalyptic world populated by bizarre characters and creatures, with a surreal and comedic tone.

name: Amores Verdaderos
summary: Victoria, an important and well-known Mexican businesswoman, and José Ángel, a simple and honest man who has dedicated his life to the countryside, by chance meet Victoria, saving her life and over time a love relationship will arise.

name: Francisco, el matemático
summary: A maths teacher is hired by Jimmy Carter Elementary School, where he must deal with the rebellious attitudes of some students.

name: Lost Treasures of the Bible
summary: This immersive series follows archaeological teams across the Middle East as they embark on a new season of excavations, uncovering the cities and civilizations featured in the Bible. From the lost city of Exodus in Egypt to the epic Tower of Babel in Iraq, their discoveries shed new light on the Bible's most famous stories. Stunning CGI and embedded cameras reveal treasures buried for millennia.

name: TMZ Presents: The Downfall of Diddy
summary: TMZ dives deep inside the latest Diddy headlines.

name: My Generation
summary: My Generation takes an in-depth look at four distinct generations and how members of each have been shaped by the cultural and political events of their time.

name: Les Chroniques de Gliwensbourg
summary: Winter 1915, a French trench was shelled, all the soldiers were buried leaving only one survivor. Underground, he manages to extract himself and crawl into a hole leading to a tunnel. Then begins a journey which will embark our soldier in the mysterious village of Gliwensbourg, in 1925 ...

previousepisode.name: The most beautiful person in the world

name: Leche
summary: Colombian comedy miniseries about Zoroastro, a mineralist who arrives at the hacienda la vía láctea to find his reincarnated mother, there he meets Susana, the daughter of the hacienda's owner and who is about to get engaged in marriage with the nephew of the woman who lives with his father.

name: Sabor a limón
summary: Three recently orphan teenagers struggle to survive life by themselves. With the help of friends and neighbors from their small apartment's community, they learn to survive life and accept their new reality .

name: Beat the Pack
summary: Jake Humphrey hosts the general knowledge quiz where contestants can win up to £12,000 if they can give a correct answer to a question before all their opponents in The Pack do. Contestants in control must play a strategic game to take home as much money as they can.

name: Love Scout
summary: A successful and confident woman, Kang Ji Yun, is the CEO of a headhunting company. To survive in the fiercely competitive headhunting field, she puts everything she has into her work. Outside of her job, she doesn't know how to do anything. She has a secretary named Yoo Eun Ho who takes care of pretty much everything for her. Unlike his boss, the secretary is friendly, well-mannered, and considerate of other people. He is a single father, who is also good at parenting and housework.

name: Go For It, Nakamura-kun!!
summary: Love at first sight is no myth—just ask Okuto Nakamura. Whenever his dreamy classmate Aiki Hirose enters the room, his heart skips a beat, despite the fact that they've never actually spoken. Not to mention, Nakamura is a complete klutz with zero friends. Will he ruin his chance at love before it even begins?

name: Mysterious Islands
summary: Mysterious Islands takes viewers on an unforgettable adventure to explore the most enigmatic islands on the planet. Weaving together CGI, archival footage, and expert testimony—and with up to four incredible stories per one-hour episode—it's a wild ride as these incredible outposts gradually reveal their secrets.

name: De unge kærester
summary: "He's an old pig." "You could have been his mother." "Find someone your own age." We follow four couples who open up about a taboo in the innermost and most intimate part of their lives - they have found love with someone who is significantly older than themselves. The age difference between them often goes to the limit in relation to what many believe is appropriate in a love relationship.

name: Читатели
summary: A show in which guests will talk about their favorite books, we will check how well they understand literature and share recommendations on which books are worth reading and which are better left in the store.

name: After the Flash Marriage, I Was in the Hands of the Big Man
summary:
Song Cha fell in love with Wan Ni at first sight, and snatched Wan Ni and Hu En's bride on their wedding day, and forcefully married Wan Ni.

After the marriage, Song Cha protected his wife domineeringly, and Wan Ni was gradually moved by Song Cha.

When Hu En learned that Wan Ni had changed her mind, he felt jealous and accidentally killed Wan Ni's father and framed the blame on Song Cha.

The three of them faced off in an abandoned factory. Hu En wanted to kill the two of them, but Song Cha counterattacked.

In the end, the police arrived and punished Hu En. Song Cha got his wish after pursuing his wife, but he was also punished for the crime he committed.

name: Eternal Butler
summary: The story happened after the departure of Ever 9, who fell in love with a human. The leader of the Ever series, Ever 4, in order to fight for his rights as an AI, was sent to the Luo family as a deacon and bodyguard. Facing the rebellious young master of the family, Luo Bu Shi, how can Ever 4, who is used to being in control, keep his young master in line? Due to his family's financial situation, Lin Jia Qian worked at construction sites and delivery during school breaks, as well as at a cafe during holidays. One time Lin Jia Qian was being chased by a gangster on his way to collect a debt, he bumped into Zhou Zhen Qun. Lin Jia Qian recognised at first sight that Zhou Zhen Qun was the person he had been waiting for, and this fated encounter started.

previousepisode.name: Happiness is great, don't you think?

name: Bad Influencer
summary: Donna only wanted a nice, casual sex date, but her chosen one, Pascal, is a man-influencer for whom she's nothing more than another item in his 7-one-night-in-7-day challenge. Without her consent, he films her naked in bed and even streams the whole thing. But Donna literally strikes back by kicking Pascal in the groin on camera. The video goes viral, and so does Donna. At first, it looks like her life is ruined. But Donna isn't so easily defeated. With her best friend and roommate, Milou, she makes her own video and launches a counterattack against pick-up artist Pascal and all the toxic incels on the internet. She announces that within a month she'll have more followers than Pascal—a mere 1.5 million, after all.

name: Iris
summary: Like everyone else, Iris has a head. Only her head... isn't exactly like everyone else's. And neither is her mouth, which says things that other mouths don't say. Her boyfriend, her cousin, a wine merchant, a museum guard. The list of those she pushes to the limit grows every day. But ultimately, the first to suffer is Iris.

name: Cookie Cupcake Cake
summary: Which of America's best bakers can master mind-blowingly inventive, visually stunning, decadently delicious desserts in three top sweets categories? Every standalone episode of this totally fresh, utterly appealing dessert competition series challenges pro baker-decorators to conquer the three "C's" of sweets in escalating rounds of detail, flavor complexity, and grandeur. Welcome to Cookie Cupcake Cake!

name: Cake Toppers
summary: Buddy Valastro hosts Cake Toppers, a cake competition with a wicked twist! Round one, artists create detailed cakes; round two the final teams must swap cakes and elevate designs! It's a game of artistry, strategy, and cake engineering asking, can you top that?

name: Interview with a Killer
summary: In a gripping new Court TV original documentary series, host David Scott (HBO Real Sports, ABC News) ventures inside high-security prisons to delve into the minds of convicted murderers. Through in-depth interviews and direct confrontations, Scott seeks to uncover the motives and mindsets that led these individuals to commit murder. The series offers a rare glimpse into the psychological and emotional factors driving heinous crimes, providing viewers with a chilling yet insightful look at some of the most dangerous criminals behind bars.

previousepisode.name: Trophy Wife Unmasked - Celeste Beard Johnson

name: Cape Fear
summary: A storm is coming for happily married attorneys Anna and Tom Bowden when Max Cady, the notorious killer they are responsible for putting behind bars, is let out of prison - and he wants vengeance.

name: Anonim
summary: What would happen if the strange events in world history happened today? People taking photos with their dead relatives, methods that enable men to feel the pain of women's birth, interesting rules in the first Olympics... Anonim searches for the answer to this question through different examples.

name: Luca's Key Ingredient
summary: Luca's Key Ingredient is an exciting seven-part cooking show where each episode Chef Luca Ciano will take your taste buds on a journey showcasing some exceptional Italian and Australian produce. He will share some insights on some key ingredient history and plate up meals that will leave you feeling true Italian love on a plate.

name: Almost Delicious
summary: Fang Meng, who has had a misaligned sense of taste since childhood, takes over the struggling 'Hua Su' restaurant after her father's death. With the help of Shu Zhengyan, she continuously tries and works hard. From a beginner who could only make 'dark cuisine,' she finally succeeds in turning 'Hua Su' into the most iconic restaurant in the city. After overcoming numerous hardships, she and Shu Zhengyan share a life together.

name: Nijntje en haar vriendjes
summary: Animated series about the adventures of Miffy and her friends.

name: Charming China
summary: A trip along the Yangtze River from Shanghai to Shangri-la, through the Three Gorges, documenting the amazing sights and experiences in that region.

name: My Contractual Husband
summary: Gu Ping'an arrives in Qiantang to investigate an unsolved case left by his late father. There, he encounters Song Shirui, who is troubled by the "single tax" she has to pay. The two pretend to be a married couple and open a restaurant together. During their journey as business partners, they develop feelings for each other, overcome fierce competition in the restaurant industry, and uncover the criminal forces entrenched in Qiantang. Together, they bring justice to Gu Ping'an's father's unresolved case.

name: On the Fly
summary: Join Gavin Hurley as he breaks down the secrets of the fly fishing artform while taking you to some of the world's most amazing destinations. From a sparkling stream just out of a busy city, a fish rich river in the mountains, or a sand flat in literally the centre of the ocean, every fish you target can be caught on a fly and Gavin will show you how On the Fly.

name: Calling from the Galaxy
summary: At both ends of the Milky Way reside the Emperors of the North and South, masters of life and death for all beings. One day, amid a game of strategy, a wager is struck with "romance" as the stake, placing life and death at the mercy of heaven's trials. The Northern Dipper's Mystic Pearl descends to the mortal realm to endure three lifetimes of trials by love.

name: There's No Freaking Way I'll Be Your Lover! Unless...
summary:
Renako Amaori is leaving her awkward and lonely junior high school life behind, determined to become a normal girl with normal friends in high school. Glamorous, confident Mai Ouzuka is Renako's total opposite: wealthy, outgoing, and a literal fashion model. Against the odds, the two girls form an immediate connection. Renako thinks she may have found the best friend of her dreams…until Mai's romantic confession sends her into a tailspin. Renako wants to prove to Mai that being BFFs is better than being girlfriends, but Mai is dead set on convincing Renako that they're destined to be lovers.

Theatrical movie with the same title, subtitled "Next Shine", released on November 21, 2025 was a direct follow-up to this anime, later split and broadcast as 5 TV special episodes.

previousepisode.name: No Freaking Way Summer Break Is Over!

name: Nevertheless: The Shapes of Love
summary: Ren Kosaka arrives in Japan to take up a special temporary lecturer position at an art university in Kamakura, Japan. He is a young and talented artist, who has a certain aura about him to make people want to get closer to him, but he also keeps a certain distance from everyone around him. Like butterflies that surround a flower, he is surrounded by other people. One day, he meets a certain woman and, because of her, his emotions begin to change. Even though he knows it will hurt ... nevertheless.

previousepisode.name: I Know Forever Doesn't Exist, But Nevertheless

name: The Toy Castle
summary: The adventures of toys who come to life when no-one's watching.

previousepisode.name: Not Your Party / No Girls Allowed / Meow Meow's Birthday

name: Moonward
summary: Moonward: A Midst Roleplaying Story is a four-part mini-series set shortly after the events of the Midst podcast and features a cast of characters on an unsanctioned rescue mission to the sunken remains of Midst's destroyed moon. Only problem is this moon currently resides in a cosmic ocean of spooky darkness known as the Fold and the Fold is filled with tearrors that cause unknown reality-bending mayhem to those exposed… What could possibly go wrong ? Are you with us so far ?

name: Bir Yemin Ettim
summary: Kerim's relationship with Ecrin, the daughter of the person he thinks is his father's murderer, starts with hostility and moves to another level, and the two young people start working together to find the real murderer. Kerim and Ecrin, who become more attached to each other with every obstacle they encounter, soon fall into an impossible love.

name: Brocéliande
summary: Logre, the famous ogre who reigns over the magical creatures of the kingdom of Logres, takes a very dim view of the quest for the Grail in which Arthur has embarked. He therefore decides to set up a machine to reduce the powers of Merlin, the famous enchanter. Odilon, an archer of the King, learns of the stratagem. Helped by Alan the bard, he will do everything to thwart the plans of the King of Brocéliande. On their way, they will meet a series of colorful characters like Blööm and Pace, two elves trying to cover up the crime of a knight of the Round Table that they have committed; as well as Ferrigno and Zif, an orc and a goblin, soldiers of the army of Logre.

name: Pat Callinan's 4×4 Adventures
summary: Join Pat Callinan as he explores some of the most amazing and visually stunning places in Australia on Pat Callinan's 4×4 Adventures.

name: The Kings of Tupelo: A Southern Crime Saga
summary: A small-town feud, an internet conspiracy, an Elvis impersonator, black market body parts, and an assassination attempt on the President. Welcome to Mississippi where this jaw-dropping story spirals from local drama to a national scandal. Buckle up for a wild ride. This isn't fiction — it's Tupelo.

name: Murri Rugby League Carnival 2024
summary: The Qld Murri Carnival is an annual four-day rugby league carnival for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islanders Queensland rugby league teams.

name: Transblack
summary: Transblack follows the day-to-day life of four Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander transgender men and women.

name: Amor da Minha Vida
summary: If the love of your life was by your side the whole time, how long would it take for you to realize it? Bruna Marquezine and Sérgio Malheiros star in this irresistible romantic comedy about the ups and downs of Bia and Victor, their love lives, and unshakable friendship.

name: Mamen Mayo
summary: Mamen Mayo and her mediation team attempt to resolve conflicts of interest within families entangled in inheritance disputes.

name: The Yes Experiment
summary: Parents confront their kid's wildest dreams as they give over control for an entire day.

name: Planet Shapers
summary: Sustainability stories about innovating, adapting and changing the way we live and work. Presenters Laura Wells and Jo Taranto travel across Australia to hear first hand from people making real change. The need to be more sustainable is now an accepted part of life. From recycling waste at home, to large scale renewable energy, there is innovation and change all around us. Planet Shapers reveals the people and organisations leading the way. Sharing knowledge and inspiring others to live and work more sustainably.

name: Карамболь
summary: Carom is a situation in billiards when a ball bouncing off another ball must ricochet into the third. The world is small, and evil deeds, as well as good ones, certainly affect the fate of third people and, as a result, can turn into the most unexpected side - Natalya Silantyeva is a beautiful, young, successful owner of a modeling agency. A loving husband, a wonderful son, a beloved job - what else is needed for happiness? But the quiet life comes to an end when it turns out that her first husband, who was presumed dead, is actually alive. Now too many people want to find him, hoping to reach him through Natalya.

name: Dark Side of the Cage
summary: Cutting through the glamour and glory of the MMA spectacle to reveal never-before-told stories behind its fighters.

previousepisode.name: Chael Sonnen: Becoming the Bad Guy

name: It's Not Like That
summary: It's Not Like That follows Lori, who is freshly divorced with two teens. Malcolm's a minister and recently widowed dad of three. Their families once did everything together, but now Lori and Malcolm must navigate their newly minted singledom, parenthood and the complexities of Malcolm being a modern-day minister. Is this the beginning of a love story? It's not like that. Or is it?

previousepisode.name: Hope and Peace and Joy and Love

name: Ekam
summary: It explores different stories set in a place and see how each of their paths leads to 'Ekam'; defined not as one, but where everything comes together as one.

name: Líf kviknar
summary: An Icelandic series based on the book Kviknar, which covers conception, pregnancy, childbirth, and postpartum recovery. Kviknar is a blend of factual information, personal stories, and answers to common questions.

name: Girls Gone Wild: The Untold Story
summary: Before the spread of social media and easy access to online porn, Joe Francis' multi-million dollar "Girls Gone Wild" franchise, a series of tapes sold on late night television that featured young spring breakers baring their breasts for T-shirts and hats, had a shocking grip on popular culture. Including Francis' first in-depth, in-person, on-the-record interview with a journalist in almost a decade, as well as exclusive access to his former employees, enemies, and survivors, Girls Gone Wild: The Untold Story offers an astonishing and wide-ranging account of a man whose impact on American culture cannot be overstated, whose alleged sins are numerous, and who now lives in exile on a sprawling estate in Mexico amidst the rubble of his once mighty empire.

name: Saudi Pro League: Kickoff
summary: Watch the action unfold in this gripping football documentary series, where global icons join local stars to reshape the league in its 2023/2024 season.

name: Budget Battlers
summary:
Get ready to embark on a transformative journey of creativity and resilience when Budget Battlers premieres on Wednesday, December 4, at 8.30pm on Channel 9  and 9Now. 

Hosted by former Block favourites, Jess Eva and Norm Hogan, this groundbreaking new series tackles full-blown makeovers with an unprecedented challenge: transforming four different Aussie homes in four weeks on the tightest budget yet seen on Australian television. 

As inflation, soaring living costs and interest rate increases keep the idea of home renovation out of reach for many, Budget Battlers arrives to prove that dreams can still come true – on a budget. 

The Budget Battlers team gears up with just $10,000 per home, a group of selfless volunteers and only five working days, to inspire viewers with jaw-dropping transformations, changing the lives of those who need it the most.

name: Kolleginnen
summary: Newly separated investigator Irene has to reinvent herself in her late 40s. Not so easy when you have Julia, her husband's lover, as a colleague.

name: Venice From Above
summary: Cameras capture Venice from the air to demonstrate how the rising waters shape this incredible city and the secret engineering that makes it possible.

name: 999 Murderer Calling
summary: Scheming killers call 999, set out to escape justice, deceive police and lie about committing murder, only to be damned by their own words. Detectives unravel the false trails and deception within the 999 call to expose the trust and catch the killer.

name: Our Big Day
summary: Black couples fuse modern trends and proud cultural heritage to create the dream wedding.

name: We Got Time Today
summary: Deion Sanders and Rocsi Diaz discuss the latest in news, culture, entertainment, and sports as well as conduct interviews with celebrity guests.

name: Misfortune Miss and Lucky Mr
summary: Editor Xiao Qiu had just finished evaluating a cringe-worthy Mary Sue novel and firmly rejected it during the approval meeting. However, after taking a quick nap in her wardrobe, she wakes up in another world. To her shock, she realizes she has transmigrated into the very novel she had dismissed and has become the unluckiest supporting character, Shen Qingge! Although she has the author's "golden cheat" ability to see everyone's luck value, her own luck is disastrously low, attracting all kinds of misfortune. The novel's system informs her that only by staying close to the "lucky charm" male lead, Gu Yichen, can her luck value increase—and only then will she have a chance to return home.

name: Från Insidan
summary: The gang criminals Yousef, Elias and Alex are all three in prison and are stuck in a vicious cycle of violence and crime. Inside the institution, a life and death power struggle is going on: who is your friend and who can you really trust? Through the conversations with the prison psychologist, hope arises for a better life - but how difficult is it to break away from a criminal lifestyle and take the step to another life?

name: Annem Ankara
summary: Zuhal Soydaşlı is a mother of three, married to Hasan,a man emotionally distant and shaped by a troubled childhood. After discovering his infidelity, Zuhal, once a respected officer, struggles to rebuild her life and care for her children.

name: Love Never Lies: South Africa
summary: In South Africa's first dating show of its kind, six couples face temptations — and a ruthless lie detector — in the ultimate relationship test.

name: Engor Dreams at 18
summary: A distant father and son are brought together by a twist of fate that sends Lin Zihao back to his father Lin Jiaxu's 18-year-old self, into the golden era of the 90s. Here, Zihao discovers a different side of his father, and the two even become "best buddies." Together, they navigate the highs and lows of youth, with Zihao using his knowledge of the future to revive the spirit of Engor and create a business legend in this vibrant era.
